A Salve for sundry sores called
the Leaden glaister
XXVII
Take one pt of oyle oliue of the best Take colour
lead very well calcinated with dust 12 ounces of
Spanish sope incorporate all these well together in
an earthen pot well glased or when the colour is in=
corporated that the softe comes aboue melt or put it vpon
a small fire of coales continewinge the said fire an
houre or a halfe still stirring it on a bolt of brown
fastned to a sticke of wood, yt make it fire some
what sugar, till the reddnes be turned into a gray
colour but yt must not haue stirringe till the
matter be turned into the coulour of oyle somewhatt
darker, then drop it on a woaden trencher if it
neither cleue to yt fingers nor the trencher fauorably
enough then dippe the clotte in that, the character of
thereon dipped will last 20 yeares, pt of glory of bones
this glaister laid to the stomach Cureths appetites and
takes away the paines of the Stomach laid to the
belles, tis a remedy for the Collicke laid to the
raignes of the back it stops the bloody fluxe
Openings of the vaines theat of the Kidneys worketh
of the backe, it heales all swellings, Aches & Bruises, it
Breakes ffellons, Impostumes, pushes or stiles them in
bringes applyed to the fundament it heales all diseases
thereon laid to the head, it is good for the swinnig

in Childbed
